SHIPPED: Rewrote all three hooks (message, session_start/session_end curation) from Python/bun scripts to pure shell using curl and jq.
SIGNIFICANCE: Eliminates the bun fd leak / zombie process crash that required reboots. Each hook is now a simple curl call with no runtime dependencies.
ENABLES: Stable long-running sessions without accumulating background processes.
NOTE: settings.json was updated to reference the new shell scripts. Session restart required to pick up changes.
